content: EspoCRM REST API: API Key auth (simplest, create API User in Administration > API Users, assign a Role for scope) or HMAC auth (most secure: X-Hmac-Authorization = base64(apiKey:HMAC-SHA256(method+uri, secretKey))). Webhooks (Administration > Webhooks) can only be created by API Users or Admins; API User needs 'Webhooks' scope + access to target entity types; incoming webhook payload authenticity verified via Signature header (X-Signature before v9, Signature from v9-v11). All Community edition, free.
